Çin 43 milyar dolar harcadı, hâlâ yapamadı. Litografi makinesi. Yapabilen firma sayısı: 1. ASML, Hollanda. Yapmaya yakın firma sayısı: 0. 100.000 parça. 5.000 tedarikçi. 60 ülke. ASML'in kendisi sadece %15'ini üretiyor. Ama bir araya getirip çalıştırabilen tek firma onlar. Tedarik zincirinin kalbi Almanya. Aynalar Zeiss, lazer TRUMPF. İkisinin de alternatifi yok. Zeiss bu aynaları atomdan ince parlatıyor. Almanya büyüklüğüne büyütsen en büyük pürüz 0.1 milimetre. Bu hassasiyeti ölçecek aleti bile başka kimse yapamıyor. 1 megawatt elektrik giriyor, cipe ulaşan ışık 25 watt. Dünyanın en pahalı makinesi, insanlık tarihinin en verimsiz ışık kaynağıyla çalışıyor. Nikon denedi, bıraktı. Canon denedi, bıraktı. Her şeyi kendi içlerinde çözmeye çalıştılar. 100.000 parçalık sistemi tek başına götüremezsin. ASML farklı yaptı. Müşterilerini ortak etti. Intel, Samsung, TSMC 2012'de toplam 5.4 milyar dolar yatırdı. Hisse karşılığı. Müşterileri aynı zamanda yatırımcısı oldu. Çin deneme aşamasında. SMEE henüz ticari ölçekte DUV makinesi satabilmiş değil. EUV prototipi gizli laboratuvarda. 3.000'den fazla araştırmacı. Bir kısmı eski ASML çalışanı. Makineyi söküp kopyalamaya çalışıyorlar. Henüz tek çip basabilmiş değiller. 1984'te Philips'in arka bahçesinde, yağmur sızdıran bir barakada 31 kişiyle kuruldu. Bugün piyasa değeri ~700 milyar dolar. Bu makine olmadan 5 nanometrenin altına inilemez. Çin'in prototipi 150 watt üretiyor. ASML'inki 600. Aradaki fark en az 10-15 yıl. nitter.perennialte.ch/inertiaaaaaa/status/18… Video

At Pacific Cyber Week’s Women in Cyber Networking Breakfast hosted by PaCSON, we celebrated and honoured the contributions of our amazing women who make up the ICT and cyber security industry. In particular, we commemorated Ms Georgina Kiele from PNG Department of ICT, who was committed to PNG’s cyber resilience. The inspirational women who joined me on my panel shared their experiences and commitment to uplifting women and creating inclusive spaces now and into the next generation. Tonga Attorney-General and Chair of the PILON Cybercrime Working Group Linda Folaumoetui shared her own experience of finding creative ways to network, which is respectful of local cultures. Georgina Naigulevu from Fiji reminded us to build accessibility considerations into our approaches, our technology and our Digital Public Infrastructure solutions for the future – a timely reminder of the importance of inclusivity for persons with a disability. Czech Cyber Attache to the Indo-Pacific Veronika Kolek Netolická shared her journey over her career in cyber, and her establishment of the first women in cyber network in the Czech Republic. Diane Kambanei outlined her advocacy for women’s rights in online spaces, and the PNG Government’s commitments to combatting technology-facilitated gender-based violence. Honoured to highlight the contributions and leadership by women in cyber in our Pacific.

The initiative will reduce out-of-pocket spending and bring health services closer to communities. I reaffirmed @WHO's commitment to supporting Ghana's efforts to achieve #HealthForAll, and thanked the President for joining us in person at #WHA79. #WATCH | Chandigarh: On the alleged paper leak issue in Punjab and amendment bill, Former Minister and Senior leader, Shiromani Akali Dal, Daljit Singh Cheema says, "... The government is proposing amendments to the paper leak law to impose stricter penalties, including fast-track courts, quicker investigations, fines of up to Rs 10 crore, and increasing the minimum prison sentence from three to five years, and the maximum sentence of ten years... The priority should be preventing paper leaks in the first place through stronger security protocols and clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). The law was enacted in 2024, yet amendments are already needed, suggesting it was introduced without fully addressing all issues. Future efforts should focus more on prevention than on harsher punishment alone. It is also worth considering whether all examinations need to be centrally conducted. As a federal country, India should empower states to conduct their own entrance examinations, while the Government of India provides security standards, SOPs, and tech support. Given the vast geographical, linguistic, infrastructural, and technological differences across states, a single centralised system remains vulnerable to paper leaks. Since states already provide the infrastructure, staff, police, and examination centres, they should be trusted with greater responsibility. Strengthening cooperative federalism and reducing the trust deficit between the Centre and the states would create a more secure examination system and better protect students' interests..." Video

महाआरोग्य शिबिरातून आरोग्यसेवा शेवटच्या घटकापर्यंत पोहोचविण्याचा संकल्प मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस आणि केंद्रीय मंत्री नितीन गडकरी यांनी नागपूर येथे मुख्यमंत्री सहाय्यता निधी व धर्मादाय रुग्णालय मदत कक्ष, नागपूर यांच्या समन्वयाने आयोजित महाआरोग्य शिबिरास प्रमुख उपस्थिती दर्शवली. 'सेवा हाच आमचा धर्म' या भावनेतून वैद्यकीय क्षेत्रात उल्लेखनीय कार्य उभे राहिले आहे. विविध डायग्नोस्टिक सेंटर्स, एनसीआयसारख्या संस्थांच्या माध्यमातून गरिबांपर्यंत दर्जेदार आरोग्यसेवा पोहोचविण्याचे काम सुरू आहे. समाज निरोगी राहावा आणि पैशाअभावी कोणताही रुग्ण उपचारापासून वंचित राहू नये, यासाठी राज्य सरकार प्रयत्नशील असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यावेळी म्हणाले. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस म्हणाले, महाआरोग्य शिबिरामागचा उद्देश समाजातील शेवटच्या व्यक्तीपर्यंत तज्ज्ञ आरोग्यसेवा पोहोचविण्याचा आहे. आपण राज्य सरकारच्या विविध योजना राबवत आहोत, सरकारची रुग्णालये आहेत, मेडिकल कॉलेजेस आहेत, अनेक धर्मादाय संस्था उत्तम काम करत आहेत. या सर्वांच्या माध्यमातून समाजातील शेवटच्या घटकापर्यंतच्या प्रत्येक व्यक्तीला एकाच छताखाली सर्व सुविधा उपलब्ध होत आहेत. या महाआरोग्य शिबिरात सर्व तज्ज्ञ डॉक्टर्स एका व्यासपीठावर एकत्र आले आणि 31,000 रुग्णांची तपासणी करण्यात आली. त्यापैकी उपचारांची आवश्यकता असलेल्या रुग्णांसाठी आवश्यक व्यवस्था करण्यात आली असून, पुढील टप्प्यात विविध प्रकारच्या इंटरव्हेन्शन्स, ऑपरेशन्स आणि प्रोसिजर्सची गरज असलेल्या 5000 रुग्णांवरही पूर्णपणे निःशुल्क उपचार करण्यात येणार आहेत. केंद्र व राज्य सरकारच्या 'प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना' आणि 'महात्मा ज्योतिराव फुले जन आरोग्य योजने'च्या माध्यमातून राज्यातील 12 कोटी नागरिकांना युनिव्हर्सल आरोग्य संरक्षण देण्यात आले आहे. या योजनेंतर्गत 1200 वरून 2300 आजारांचा समावेश करण्यात आला असून, ₹5,00,000 पर्यंतचे उपचार मोफत उपलब्ध आहेत. तसेच, तिप्पट रुग्णालये जोडून खासगी आणि धर्मादाय रुग्णालयांमध्येही ही सेवा उपलब्ध करण्यात आली आहे. तसेच, 'मुख्यमंत्री सहाय्यता निधी'चा विस्तार करत या कार्यकाळातील गेल्या दीड वर्षांत या निधीच्या माध्यमातून 5700 रुग्णांना₹452 कोटींची मदत देण्यात आली आहे. यासोबतच धर्मादाय निधीही एकत्रित करण्यात आला असून, धर्मादाय रुग्णालयांतील गरिबांसाठी राखीव खाटांबाबतची माहिती 100% डिजिटल प्लॅटफॉर्मवर आणण्यात आली आहे. त्यामुळे खाटांची उपलब्धता, रुग्ण, उपचार आणि खर्चाची थेट माहिती मिळत असून, धर्मादाय रुग्णालयांमध्येही अनेक मोफत शस्त्रक्रिया करण्याची व्यवस्था सुरू करण्यात आली असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस म्हणाले, ₹5,00,000 च्या मर्यादेत न बसणाऱ्या सुमारे 10 गंभीर आजारांसाठी शासनाकडून ₹9,00,000 पर्यंत, तर काही प्रोसिजर्ससाठी ₹35,00,000 पर्यंत आर्थिक मदत दिली जात आहे. त्यामुळे आर्थिक अडचणीमुळे कोणताही रुग्ण उपचार किंवा शस्त्रक्रियेपासून वंचित राहणार नाही. कॉक्लिअर इम्प्लांटसारख्या महागड्या शस्त्रक्रियांसाठी ₹6,00,000 ते ₹10,00,000 पर्यंत खर्च येतो. मात्र, CÍRCULO ROJO: EL NUEVO ESQUEMA DE PODER LIBERTARIO Y LAS INTERNAS QUE INQUIETAN AL PRO Y AL PERONISMO | Por Federico Mayol El rediseño del Gobierno, el dominio total de Karina Milei y el ascenso de Diego Santilli. El rol de Santiago Caputo. El acuerdo en la Justicia. Horas cruciales en la disputa entre los primos Macri. La decisión que esperan los intendentes. Presión a Kicillof para la ruptura definitiva El Gobierno rediseña su nuevo esquema de funcionamiento interno con la reelección de Javier Milei como norte, en medio de señales ambivalentes en la actividad económica pero con una ventaja que, al menos por ahora, le da aire a su plan: la escasez de propuestas y la debilidad de la oposición, enredada en una disputa brutal que mantiene en vilo al sistema político de la provincia de Buenos Aires. En ese nuevo esquema oficial, Karina Milei concentró el dominio total de las decisiones y el control del Gabinete, y parece haber entendido que el pragmatismo es una condición necesaria para administrar el poder. Bajo esa lógica se inscribe la incorporación a su ecosistema de relaciones de Diego Santilli, un profesional de la política que se convirtió en uno de los interlocutores principales con los gobernadores. También el desembarco de Fabián Fernández, otro profesional respetado por el sistema y el círculo rojo que la Secretaria General adoptó como propio, que incluyó en la mesa política y al que le dio vía libre para ordenar la comunicación oficial. Distinto es el caso del vocero Adrián Ravier, que llegó impulsado por el Presidente y que el viernes aseguró que la divisa norteamericana podía alcanzar los $1.800 en medio de los anuncios para facilitar el uso de dólares en la economía, una medida trabajada por Luis Caputo, “Toto”, un intocable del gabinete. Esa declaración de Ravier despertó serios reproches internos, en especial de la hermana presidencial, que no está para nada conforme con la performance del funcionario. La Secretaria General y Santilli conformaron una dupla estrecha, casi similar al vínculo de la hermanísima con los Menem. Incluso ella trabó una muy buena relación con Fabián Pereira, hoy tal vez el colaborador más cercano del jefe de Gabinete junto a Gustavo Coria. Ese vínculo le permitió al ministro coordinador avanzar sobre determinadas áreas como la estratégica Secretaria de Ciencia, Innovación y Tecnología todavía a cargo de Darío Genua, al que le buscan reemplazo. Genua tuvo en su momento una ligazón estrecha con Bruno Screnci, un viejo amigo, muy simbiótico, del ex ministro del Interior con el que se distanció hace años por diferencias políticas, una pelea que dio que hablar en su momento en el círculo rojo. Santilli pensó como sucesor de Genua a Gastón Navarro, pero el reemplazo sigue bajo análisis. 🔗bit.ly/4x0Im1X

LA ENFERMERA QUE CUIDÓ A EVITA EN SU LECHO DE MUERTE: “YO LE CERRÉ LOS OJITOS, YA NO IBA A DESPERTAR; PERÓN LLORABA COMO UN NENE” | Por Julieta Roffo María Eugenia Álvarez tiene 99 años. Asistió a la Primera Dama cuando votó por primera vez y en sus últimos días, cuando el cáncer ya era irreversible. La reconoció por los ojos. Algo de esos ojos verdes cautivaron a Eva Perón, que, cuando su salud se deterioraba de manera irreversible, le dijo a su marido, el Presidente de la Nación: “Que venga a la chica de los ojos verdes”. Hablaba de María Eugenia Álvarez, que en 1952 tenía 23 años y que había visto por primera vez a Evita dos años antes, en el Hospital Rivadavia, donde se formaba como enfermera. Eva había ido a visitar a algunas trabajadoras de la salud que dependían de la fundación que llevaba su nombre y que habían tenido un accidente. Allí, en el hospital de Recoleta que quedaba a apenas metros del Palacio Unzué, Eva le estrechó la mano a María Eugenia por primera vez. Ninguna de las dos sabía lo que les deparaba el futuro: la enfermera iba a ser, algunos meses después, quien le cerrara los ojos a Eva en su lecho de muerte. “Yo tenía la vocación de ser enfermera desde siempre. Cuando era chica a iba a la escuela, en el recreo jugaba a curar, a cuidar pacientes. Después, una hermana mía se enfermó y ahí vi de cerca el trabajo de las enfermeras, y me convencí para siempre”, le cuenta ahora María Eugenia Álvarez a Infobae. Tiene 99 años y vive en una residencia geriátrica de Monte Grande. Se puso, para esta entrevista, un pañuelo con el retrato de la mujer que protagonizó la historia argentina del siglo XX y a la que ella asistió hasta el final. 🔗bit.ly/45nFtMV

প্রবাসের মাটিতে নিজের শেষ সম্বলটুকু হারালেও, হারিয়ে যায়নি তার মানবিকতা ও উদারতা। মালয়েশিয়ায় নিয়োগকর্তা বেতন না দিয়ে পালিয়ে যাওয়ায় গত তিন মাস ধরে চরম আর্থিক অনটনে দিন কাটাচ্ছেন এক বাংলাদেশি অভিবাসী কর্মী। বন্ধুদের দেওয়া ডিম খেয়ে কোনোমতে বেঁচে থাকা এই প্রবাসী চরম বিপদের দিনেও এক অনন্য দৃষ্টান্ত স্থাপন করেছেন। সম্প্রতি সুবাং বিস্তারি থেকে জালান ক্লাং যাওয়ার পথে এক অনলাইন ট্যাক্সি চালকের কাছ থেকে প্রাপ্য ৫ রিঙ্গিত ফেরত না নিয়ে, উল্টো তা হাসিমুখে বকশিস হিসেবে চালকের হাতে তুলে দেন তিনি। শনিবার (২৫ জুলাই) ‘আবাং স্টেরিং’ নামের এক ই-হেলিং (অনলাইন ট্যাক্সি) চালক থ্রেডসে পোস্ট করে হৃদয়স্পর্শী এই ঘটনার বিবরণ দেন। দুটি বড় ব্যাগ আর একটি টেবিল ফ্যান নিয়ে ট্যাক্সিতে ওঠা ওই শ্রমিক ৪০ মিনিটের পুরো যাত্রাপথজুড়েই চিন্তামগ্ন ছিলেন। চালক তার বিষণ্ণতার কারণ জানতে চাইলে তিনি মৃদু হেসে জানান, মালিক তিন মাস ধরে বেতন না দিয়ে উধাও হয়ে গেছেন। বাধ্য হয়ে বেঁচে থাকার তাগিদে ও নতুন একটি টাইলস মিস্ত্রির কাজ পাওয়ার আশায় তিনি এক বন্ধুর বাসায় উঠছেন। গন্তব্যে পৌঁছে চালক বাকি টাকা ফেরত দিতে চাইলে তিনি বিনীতভাবে তা প্রত্যাখ্যান করে বলেন, ‘এটি আপনার চায়ের খরচ, শুধু দোয়া করবেন যেন আমার নতুন কাজ পাওয়ার ব্যবস্থা হয়’। #malaysia #InternationalNews #news #somoytv

দীর্ঘ লড়াই-সংগ্রাম শেষে দাবি আদায়ের পর আন্দোলনমুক্ত জীবনের প্রথম নতুন সকালে দেশবাসীকে বিশেষ বার্তা দিয়েছেন ককরোচ জনতা পার্টির (সিজেপি) প্রতিষ্ঠাতা ও আহ্বায়ক অভিজিৎ দীপকে। রোববার (২৬ জুলাই) সকালে তিনি স্পষ্ট জানিয়ে দেন, ‘সবে তো শুরু হলো। আমাদের এখনও অনেক দূর যেথে হবে।’ এদিন প্রকাশিত এক ভিডিও বার্তায় অভিজিৎ আবেগাপ্লুত কণ্ঠে বলেন, ‘অনেক দিন পর আজ বেশ শান্তিতে ঘুমিয়েছি। সত্যিই খুব ভালো লাগছে। আজ অন্তত ভাবতে হয়নি সন্ধ্যায় কী হবে, মনে কোনো আতঙ্ক কাজ করছে না।’ তিনি বলেন, ‘গত ৩৭ দিনের দিনগুলো আমাদের কারও জন্যই সহজ ছিল না। আমি ককরোচ জনতা পার্টির প্রতিটি সমর্থক ও যন্তর-মন্তরে টানা বসে থাকা অদম্য মানুষকে ধন্যবাদ জানাতে চাই। আপনাদের এই সাহস ও অবিচল বিশ্বাস ছাড়া এই ঐতিহাসিক অর্জন সম্ভব হতো না।’ দীর্ঘ পথচলার বার্তা দিয়ে সিজেপির প্রতিষ্ঠাতা আরও বলেন, ‘আমি আবারও বলছি, সবে মাত্র শুরু, ককরোচ জনতা পার্টিকে অনেক দূর যেতে হবে।’ #International #news #somoytv

Las suposiciones en redes sociales apuntaron a lo ocurrido en el vestuario argentino antes del encuentro, alimentadas por fragmentos de la arenga de Lionel Messi en el túnel y por la superioridad de los españoles en la cancha. Las suspicacias no tardaron en aflorar tras el pitazo final, en ese marco el cuerpo técnico decidió salir al cruce para clarificar lo sucedido. Matías Manna, analista de videos de la selección, se refirió al asunto. En una entrevista con el programa Vuelta y media de Urbana Play, se mostró categórico al desestimar las versiones alternativas sobre la final: “Son cosas que pasan cuando uno pierde, a lo mejor, o sospecha que puede llegar a haber. Sobre todo en las redes de hoy está todo filmado en todo momento. Entonces, si alguien dice algo, ya empiezan a buscarle la vuelta. Pasó lo que pasó en el campo de juego, felicitar al que le fue mejor en ese partido y seguir adelante”. 🔗bit.ly/4pFLu0E

Owing to incessant use of our smartphones, many have developed texting thumb. The term texting thumb can describe a wide range of phone-related pains caused by tired-out tendons and achy joints — like general stiffness, throbbing near the knuckle and a clicking sensation when bending the thumb. If left untreated, repetitive typing and swiping can lead to more serious issues like carpal tunnel and arthritis.
Do your hands hurt when you use your phone? All that texting and scrolling might be stressing out your fingers. 🧵

A one day DRDO Aero Cluster Industry Meet was organised at Bengaluru on 25 July 2026. The sessions were specifically designed to provide the industry partners to bring out the challenges that are being faced by them during execution of various projects and to suggest ways to improve and ease the processes for timely realization of the products / Systems. Over 130 industry participated in the event During the event, the newly designed CEMILAC Certification Kit Version- 2 was released, which is envisaged to ease the process of airworthiness certification. सेंटर फॉर मॉनिटरिंग इंडियन इकॉनमी (CMIE) ने हाल ही में 2014/15 से 2025/26 के बीच के घरेलू व्यय संबंधी आंकड़ों के आधार पर एक विस्तृत विश्लेषण किया है। इसके नतीजे बिल्कुल साफ हैं- 1. शिक्षा पर होने वाला खर्च घरेलू आय की तुलना में कहीं अधिक तेज़ी से बढ़ रहा है। 2. परिवार अपनी आय का पहले की तुलना में कहीं बड़ा हिस्सा शिक्षा पर खर्च कर रहे हैं। 3. निजी ट्यूशन शिक्षा पर होने वाले घरेलू खर्च के सबसे तेज़ी से बढ़ते हिस्सों में से एक बनकर उभरा है। 4. पिछले एक दशक में स्कूल और कॉलेजों की फीस में लगातार वृद्धि हुई है, जो हर वर्ष घरेलू आय में हुई वृद्धि से अधिक रही है। 5. किताबों पर होने वाला खर्च इससे भी अधिक तेज़ी से बढ़ रहा है। यह पाठ्यपुस्तकों और संदर्भ पुस्तकों की बढ़ती कीमतों, प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं की तैयारी पर बढ़ते खर्च और अतिरिक्त अध्ययन सामग्री पर बढ़ते व्यय को दर्शा सकता है। हाल के हफ्तों में जंतर-मंतर और अन्य स्थानों पर हुए छात्र आंदोलनों की तात्कालिक वजह प्रधानमंत्री और (पूर्व) मंत्री प्रधान की जोड़ी द्वारा बनाई गई अन्यायपूर्ण और धांधलीपूर्ण परीक्षा व्यवस्था रही है। लेकिन CMIE के घरेलू व्यय संबंधी आंकड़े बताते हैं कि युवाओं और उनके अभिभावकों की पीड़ा, चिंता और आक्रोश की जड़ें इससे कहीं अधिक गहरी हैं-शिक्षा की पहुंच और सामर्थ्य, दोनों से जुड़ी समस्याओं में। वे अब तत्काल सुधारात्मक कार्रवाई की मांग कर रहे हैं।

My humble appeal to Millennials and Gen Z: We have seen how a determined generation of young people can bring even the most powerful governments to their knees. It is a reminder that the real strength of any democracy lies in the power of its people. At the same time, many celebrities, influencers, sports icons and movie stars chose to remain silent instead of standing with the youth and students of this country. Whether out of fear, caution, or self-interest, their SILENCE spoke volumes. The next time we stand in a queue to buy a movie ticket, a match ticket or subscribe to a content creator, let us pause for a moment and ask ourselves:- Does this person truly represent the values I believe in? Have they stood by the people who made their success possible? If those who enjoy our applause cannot find the courage to stand with the people when it matters most, then maybe it’s time we rethink who deserves our applause. Who we follow is our choice. Who we celebrate is our choice. Who we make famous is our choice. Remember: The audience gave them FAME. The people gave them INFLUENCE. The youth gave them RELEVANCE. When history calls for courage, silence is never neutral - it is a choice. Every ticket you buy. Every view you give. Every like, share, follow and cheer- They are not just clicks or purchases, they are ENDORSEMENTS. Spend your attention as carefully as you spend your money. Because if they cannot stand with us when it matters most, why should we continue to stand behind them? #NEET #StudentsProtest

مولانا اسلام‌جار، والی هرات، در سفر به کابل با جمشید خواجه‌یف، معاون نخست‌وزیر اوزبیکستان، وزیر ترانسپورت، وزیر معادن و هیأت همراه او دیدار کرده است. بر بنیاد خبرنامه‌ای که از سوی دفتر سخنگوی والی هرات منتشر شده، در این دیدار با اشاره به موقعیت راهبردی و ظرفیت‌های گسترده هرات در بخش‌های تجارت، صنعت، زراعت و ترانزیت، بر تقویت همکاری‌های اقتصادی، افزایش سرمایه‌گذاری، توسعه صادرات و فراهم‌سازی فرصت‌های بیشتر برای تاجران دو کشور تاکید شده است. در خبرنامه آمده که جمشید خواجه‌یف نیز توسعه روابط اقتصادی و تجاری با افغانستان را مهم دانسته و آمادگی کشورش را برای گسترش همکاری‌ها در بخش‌های تجارت، ترانسپورت، لوجستیک، صنعت و سرمایه‌گذاری اعلام کرده است. همچنین، دو طرف بر توسعه مسیرهای ترانزیتی و گسترش همکاری‌های منطقه‌ای تاکید کرده و آن را زمینه‌ساز افزایش مبادلات تجاری میان دو کشور دانسته‌اند. در این دیدار، دو طرف درباره ایجاد اتاق مشترک تجارت هرات–اوزبیکستان، برگزاری نمایشگاه‌های مشترک، افزایش حجم تجارت، توسعه صادرات محصولات هرات، توسعه دهلیز ترانزیتی اوزبیکستان–ترکمنستان–تورغندی–هرات، تسهیل صدور ویزه برای تاجران، ایجاد بندر خشک و مرکز لوجستیکی رباط پریان و استفاده از هرات به‌عنوان مرکز توزیع کالاهای اوزبیکستان گفت‌وگو کردند. #طلوع‌نیوز

Kargil Vijay Diwas 🇮🇳 At just 19 years old, Grenadier Yogendra Singh Yadav climbed the near-vertical cliffs of Tiger Hill under relentless enemy fire. Shot multiple times. Bleeding. Believed to be dead. Yet he crawled forward, destroyed the enemy bunker with a grenade, and opened the path for his comrades to capture one of Kargil’s most decisive objectives. Some heroes don’t just fight against impossible odds—they redefine what courage means. Today, we bow our heads in gratitude to Honorary Captain Yogendra Singh Yadav, Param Vir Chakra, and to every brave soul who ensured that the Tricolour flew high over Tiger Hill. भारत ऐसे वीरों का सदैव ऋणी रहेगा। 🇮🇳🙏 #KargilVijayDiwas

27 years of Kargil, and this story still gives goosebumps. 527 soldiers, 60 days. Peaks retaken above 16,000 feet. Today marks 27 years since Operation Vijay ended the Kargil War. Here's what made this victory brutal and unmatched.👇 • Fighting raged across Dras, Batalik and Kaksar from May to July 1999 • Troops scaled near-vertical cliffs to dislodge infiltrators dug into the heights • Army, Air Force's Safed Sagar and Navy's Talwar operated together • Objective for the intruders: sever the Srinagar-Leh highway lifeline • Tololing and Tiger Hill among the peaks recaptured Every ridge came back under the tricolour, won by men fighting where even breathing is hard work. That war changed how India trains and equips its soldiers for the mountains, lessons the Army still leans on today. Salute to the Bravehearts of Kargil. 🇮🇳 Video

SITREP: U.S-Iran Dynamic (Gen. Access) ICOD- 18:45 07/25/26 BLUF: Since the collapse of the U.S.-Iran MOU, both belligerents have signaled an intent to widen the conflict, with recent upscaled U.S. strikes reportedly being postponed by U.S. President Donald. J. Trump, with the hopes that the move will allow Iran time to return to the MOU framework. However, other indicators, including, potential U.S. efforts to de-risk, point to the president authorizing expanded strikes in the near-term. Key Points: - The U.S. military continues its renewed buildup of material, assets and ordnance to the region, after much of them had withdrawn from the region following the implementation of the nominal ceasefire. Ex. The below image, via @TheIntelFrog and highlighted by us, shows C-17 flights into Erbil, Iraq alone have risen significantly in the past 72 hours (blue and red), with five flights being recorded in the last 24 hours (red). - Flights within CENTCOM have also risen significantly. - U.S. President Trump has repeatedly telegraphed that the U.S. is willing to expand the tempo and scale of strikes against Iran should they fail to return back to the MOU framework or continue to threaten the safe travel of commercial maritime traffic in the Strait of Hormuz. - Iran has signaled its intent to expand the conflict also, with key Iranian decision-makers saying in the past couple weeks that any nation who hosts U.S. forces and/or aids in expanded strikes will be targeted. Iran has already expanded its kinetic responses to include Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, Oman, and the United Arab Emirates (UAE), leaving only Israel out of the nations that have been struck by Iran since the renewal of hostilities. - U.S. President Trump reportedly postponed an expanded strike campaign on Iran, according to Axios, in an effort to allow more time for diplomacy. - Despite their threats, principal Iranian decision-makers, most notably Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, continue to acknowledge that mediation efforts are ongoing. Analyst comment: Reports that the escalation in Yemen between the Houthis, the internationally recognized government in Aden, and Saudi Arabia has been nominally tied to potential ceasefire efforts between the U.S. and Iran are noted, but said escalation has so far run parallel to and not in concert with the U.S.-Iran escalation ladder. Assessment: The U.S.-Iran MOU framework failed almost as soon as it was implemented, with both sides failing to realize convergence on key points of contention, namely Lebanon and the administration of the Strait of Hormuz. Such a dynamic allowed for the resumption of hostilities and the current regional escalation. President Trump has signaled his intent, through officials making comments to news organizations, to allow for a return to the MOU framework, and so has Iran. However both sides continue to clash on the administration of the Strait of Hormuz. Iran, since the MOU’s implementation has announced that they will administer the strait and charge fees for such a service, directly clashing with the MOU’s edicts and the U.S. outlook. Therefore, it should be noted that short significant concessions from either belligerent, a return to the MOU framework is a return to such a dynamic. Key Judgement: - At the time of writing, barring significant concessions from either party, specifically surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, it is unlikely that the U.S. and Iran will realize convergence in a renewed MOU framework. - Given the current U.S. regional military buildup, President Trump’s telegraphed intentions, and de-risking measures, it is highly likely that expanded strikes will be ordered, barring a concession by either party. - With Iran’s promise to target nations that host U.S. forces/aid in strikes, it is likely that Iran, as a result of potential expanded U.S. strikes, will target Israel in retaliation, further expanding the conflict. 🇺🇸🇮🇷 Trump already fought this exact war against China... He lost. Ian Bremmer says forget Iraq or Vietnam, the real precedent is the tariff war. Trump hit Beijing expecting capitulation, China shut down the critical minerals supply chain, American factories faced going dark, and Trump backed down into engagement: "When he hits them hard, they hit back. The difference here is that Trump does not yet believe or accept that the Iranians really have far more leverage over the outcome than he is prepared to understand and accept." Two sides who agree on their relative strength negotiate. Two sides who don't keep fighting, and that disagreement is the war now. @ianbremmer Video Mario Nawfal (@MarioNawfal) 🇺🇸🇮🇷 Trump remains trapped because he still refuses to accept how much leverage Iran possesses. He still thinks overwhelming American power will eventually force Tehran to give in, and political scientist Ian Bremmer says that's the mistake keeping this war alive. Instead, Iran has shown it can keep raising the economic cost of the war without crossing Trump's red lines. Ian doesn't think Iran believes it can defeat the U.S militarily; it believes it can make continuing the war more painful than ending it. And so far, it's working. Trump keeps threatening to destroy Iran's infrastructure, eliminate its leadership and dramatically escalate the conflict. But Ian points to something more revealing than Trump's rhetoric: His actions. Despite months of fighting, Trump has avoided the biggest escalations. No ground invasion, no sustained campaign against Iran's energy sector, and no full-scale assault on the country's leadership. Even after American casualties, his instinct has repeatedly been to play them down rather than use them to justify a much wider war. And Tehran has noticed. It increasingly sees a president who talks like he's preparing for total war but behaves like someone searching for an exit. The bigger problem, Ian says, is inside the White House itself. Trump's advisers know the military and economic costs are mounting, and many want the war to end, but very few are willing to tell Trump the uncomfortable truth: Iran has far more leverage over how this ends than Washington expected. Until Trump accepts that reality, Ian believes a genuine compromise remains unlikely. @ianbremmer Video — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/MarioNawfal/status/2080728471190548732#m

Dans ces heures où les flammes éprouvent durement notre pays, la France révèle ce qu’elle est : un peuple uni, qui se serre les coudes. Merci à nos sapeurs-pompiers, à nos militaires, aux forces de sécurité civile, à nos gendarmes et policiers, ainsi qu’aux agriculteurs et entrepreneurs, qui par leur engagement et leur courage, combattent sans relâche les incendies. Tous les moyens civils et militaires sont mobilisés : moyens aériens de la Sécurité civile, Canadair, Dash, hélicoptères bombardiers d’eau, renforts venus de toute la France. Une première illustre la capacité d’adaptation de nos armées : l’A400M est engagé en appui des opérations. Aux côtés des habitants, de toutes les familles touchées, des déplacés à qui on pense, la Nation est pleinement engagée. Les maires, les élus locaux et les services de l’État, préfets et agents des Préfectures, sont en première ligne pour protéger, accompagner et préparer l’après. Ils peuvent compter sur le soutien indéfectible de la République. Merci à la Roumanie, la Croatie, l’Allemagne, au Portugal, à la Suède, la Suisse, la République tchèque et la Slovaquie pour leur précieux soutien. C’est l’Europe. Dans l’épreuve, elle fait vivre la solidarité qui la fonde. Nos pensées vont aussi à l’Espagne, à l’Italie, à la Grèce et à tous les peuples qui affrontent eux aussi les incendies. Dans le Sud-Ouest, en particulier en Gironde et dans les Landes ; dans le Sud, notamment dans le Var, les Hautes-Alpes et la Haute-Corse ; en Occitanie, en particulier dans les Pyrénées-Orientales, mais aussi partout où les flammes frappent, des milliers d’hectares ont été ravagés, des habitations détruites, des activités interrompues, des vies bouleversées. Nous reconstruirons, nous réparerons et nous serons présents aussi longtemps qu’il le faudra.

The Meeting noted the progress in the ASEAN Plus Three (APT) cooperation over the past year and discussed its future direction. The Meeting reaffirmed the commitment to further strengthening and deepening the APT process, which remains a main vehicle for advancing regional community-building and in promoting peace, stability, security, and prosperity in the East Asian region with ASEAN as the driving force. The Meeting also recognised the importance of APT cooperation in supporting the realisation of ASEAN 2045: Our Shared Future and its strategic plans, the Initiative for ASEAN Integration (IAI) Work Plan IV (2021–2025), including their contributions to the development and implementation of the IAI Work Plan V (2026–2030), as well as deeper regional integration in East Asia. The difference here is that Trump does not yet believe or accept that the Iranians really have far more leverage over the outcome than he is prepared to understand and accept." Two sides who agree on their relative strength negotiate. Two sides who don't keep fighting, and that disagreement is the war now. @ianbremmer Video Mario Nawfal (@MarioNawfal) 🇺🇸🇮🇷 Trump remains trapped because he still refuses to accept how much leverage Iran possesses. He still thinks overwhelming American power will eventually force Tehran to give in, and political scientist Ian Bremmer says that's the mistake keeping this war alive. Instead, Iran has shown it can keep raising the economic cost of the war without crossing Trump's red lines. Ian doesn't think Iran believes it can defeat the U.S militarily; it believes it can make continuing the war more painful than ending it. And so far, it's working. Trump keeps threatening to destroy Iran's infrastructure, eliminate its leadership and dramatically escalate the conflict. But Ian points to something more revealing than Trump's rhetoric: His actions. Despite months of fighting, Trump has avoided the biggest escalations. No ground invasion, no sustained campaign against Iran's energy sector, and no full-scale assault on the country's leadership. Even after American casualties, his instinct has repeatedly been to play them down rather than use them to justify a much wider war. And Tehran has noticed. It increasingly sees a president who talks like he's preparing for total war but behaves like someone searching for an exit. The bigger problem, Ian says, is inside the White House itself. Trump's advisers know the military and economic costs are mounting, and many want the war to end, but very few are willing to tell Trump the uncomfortable truth: Iran has far more leverage over how this ends than Washington expected. Тривожно 🫂 First Corps Azov of the National Guard of Ukraine (@azov_media) The advance of two armies and a tank division of the Russian armed forces was repelled: forces of the First Corps Azov of the National Guard of Ukraine destroyed dozens of units of equipment and a large number of occupier personnel. On July 22, the occupiers, using forces of the 8th and 41st Armies along with the 90th Tank Division, attempted an assault in the sector held by the First Corps Azov of the National Guard of Ukraine, involving dozens of units of armored and light vehicles. The 41st Guards Combined Arms Army and the 90th Guards Vitebsk-Novgorod Tank Division of the Russian armed forces advanced from the area of the settlement of Novoekonomichne, while forces of the 8th Guards Combined Arms Army simultaneously advanced from the area of the village of Vozdvyzhenka. For four hours, they attempted to enter settlements in the area of the village of Shakhove. The enemy attempted to deny the sky to Ukrainian forces using "Gerbera" and "Lancet" strike drones. A modern Russian "Tornado-S" MLRS, which was being used to support the assault, was also destroyed. Forces of the First Corps Azov of the National Guard of Ukraine, together with attached units, blocked the path of the advancing mechanized columns. Mine-explosive obstacles were laid on the approaches to the positions of the Ukrainian Defense Forces, and bridges were damaged by tactical aviation. During the assault, the Russians attempted to restore the crossings using pontoons, but these were destroyed by tactical aviation of the Air Force of the Armed Forces of Ukraine (AFU). As a result of the professional actions of all units involved under the command of the First Corps Azov of the National Guard of Ukraine, using barrel artillery, multiple launch rocket systems, and attack drones, the following were destroyed: 7 tanks, 6 armored combat vehicles, 1 BM-21 "Grad" MLRS, 1 "Tornado-S" MLRS, 3 units of special equipment, and 47 units of light vehicles. 123 occupiers were eliminated, and 29 were wounded. The mechanized assault was repelled. We thank the units of the First Corps Azov of the National Guard of Ukraine, the SBU's "A" Special Operations Center, the Unmanned Systems Forces, the Air Force of the AFU, units of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine, in particular the Main Department of Unmanned Aerial Systems "Fenix," units of the National Guard of Ukraine, and units of the Armed Forces of Ukraine for their professional and courageous actions. Always ready to repel the enemy's assault through joint efforts! Video — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/azov_media/status/2080974057856491559#m

For many survivors, a health worker may be the first, and sometimes the only, person they turn to. Yet not all health workers are equipped to recognise the signs or provide the necessary support. When almost 1 in 3 women and girls aged 15 and older in our Region experience physical or sexual violence in their lifetime, the health sector cannot afford to be unprepared. This is why I launched a special initiative to strengthen the health sector’s response to violence against women and girls. Training health workers is an essential part of this effort, but it must go hand in hand with the right policies and clear clinical guidance. Scotland has just done something quietly brilliant for its birds 🐦 New buildings across the country will now have to include "swift bricks", hollow bricks built straight into the walls that give birds a safe place to nest. It sounds like a small thing but it isn't. Swift numbers in the UK have fallen by around 60% since the mid-1990s, and one of the biggest reasons is heartbreakingly simple: modern buildings have nowhere for them to go. Swifts have always nested in the nooks and gaps of our houses, and as those disappeared, so did they. The birds themselves make it worse by being loyal to a fault. Swifts return to the exact same nest site year after year, having flown thousands of miles from Africa to get there. When they arrive to find it sealed up, some will keep flying at the spot again and again, sometimes injuring themselves in the process. The bricks cost about £30 each. They need no maintenance, they don't affect insulation, and once they're in the wall, you'd never know they were there. Sparrows, starlings and house martins use them too, all species in trouble for the same reason. One RSPB conservationist put it starkly. In his part of Glasgow, not a single swift bred in 2025, the first time in his 30 years there. He called it "nothing short of heartbreaking." Scotland is the first country in the UK to write this into law. Campaigners are now hoping the rest follows.

MIT filmed a calculus course in black and white decades ago and it still teaches better than most of what shipped this year. Almost nobody watches it. This is Calculus Revisited, Unit 1, Lecture 1, taught by Herb Gross. Analytic geometry from the ground up, chalk on a board, 1 camera locked in place. Gross built the course for adults returning to math after years away. No prerequisites assumed. Every idea earned in front of you instead of quoted from a textbook. The opening move is simple division written on the board. From there he shows why coordinates work at all, the thing most courses skip and every student silently fakes. Watch how slowly he goes. Each step spoken out loud, nothing left implicit, the pace of someone who expects you to actually follow. A backend engineer I know rewatched Unit 1 twice before touching linear algebra and said it fixed a gap he'd carried for 12 years. MIT put the whole course online free under Creative Commons. BOOM! OPEN SOURCE MRI! You can now 3D-print the core of an MRI scanner. A machine that hospitals pay $1.1 million to $3.4 million for has been broken open. The OSI² ONE and its educational siblings deliver real images of heads and limbs for a fraction of the cost, using a permanent-magnet Halbach array, 3D-printed structures, and fully open designs. This is not a toy or a simulation. Working systems already produce in-vivo images in Leiden, Utrecht, Berlin, and Uganda. The magnet alone—396 carefully oriented neodymium cubes in a cylindrical Halbach array—costs about $1,370. A complete scanner lands between $28,500 and $68,000 depending on the console and coils you choose. No superconducting magnets. No liquid helium. No specialized power infrastructure. It runs from a standard wall outlet and weighs roughly 150 kg. The physics is elegant. A Halbach array arranges permanent magnets so their fields reinforce inside the bore and nearly cancel outside. The result is a usable 50 mT field strong enough for diagnostic-quality imaging of extremities and the head when paired with clever gradient coils, RF coils, and modern reconstruction. Spatial resolution reaches about 1.5 × 1.5 × 5 mm³. The designs are modular: build the magnet first, verify and shim the field with a 3D-printer-turned-field-scanner, then add gradients and RF hardware. The plans are public Everything needed to replicate or improve the system lives in open repositories: • Primary project hub and documentation: opensourceimaging.org/projec… • Full OSI² repositories (hardware, software, magnets): gitlab.com/osii/ • Educational build focused on the Halbach frame, shimming, gradients, and student workshops (Utrecht / Lili’s Proto Lab): github.com/LilisProtoLab/osi… • Magnet-specific details: opensourceimaging.org/projec… Hardware is released under CERN-OHL-W. Most software is GPL-3.0. Where AI multiplies the impact Low-field MRI has historically been limited by lower signal-to-noise and greater field inhomogeneity. That is exactly the regime where modern AI thrives. Image reconstruction becomes dramatically better when deep networks trained on high-field data or physics-informed models denoise, correct for inhomogeneity, and push resolution beyond the raw acquisition limits. Real-time sequence adaptation can adjust gradients and RF pulses on the fly as the AI monitors signal quality. Magnet design itself can be optimized by evolutionary algorithms or differentiable physics engines that search for better Halbach geometries or shim placements than human intuition alone can find. Further out, local AI agents turn these scanners into autonomous diagnostic nodes. A small clinic or even a well-equipped garage workshop could run overnight scans, flag anomalies, and queue results for a remote radiologist—or eventually for a specialized medical model. Synthetic data generation from the open designs lets researchers train robust models without proprietary hospital datasets. Robotics integration (patient positioning, coil placement, maintenance) becomes straightforward once the hardware is open and standardized. In the longer arc of the Abundance Interregnum, this is the shape of things: sophisticated medical instruments that no longer require billion-dollar supply chains or national infrastructure. A distributed network of open, AI-augmented low-field scanners could bring advanced imaging to places that have never had it, while simultaneously giving makers, universities, and small labs the ability to experiment, improve, and specialize the technology. The plans are already on the table. The magnets are commercial off-the-shelf. The 3D printers exist in thousands of workshops. The AI tools for reconstruction and design optimization improve every month. What was once the exclusive domain of major hospitals is becoming a community engineering project. This is how abundance arrives—one open, reproducible, AI-extendable system at a time.

No meu discurso de posse em janeiro de 2023 resgatei, porque foi necessário, um compromisso que já havia assumido e honrado nos primeiros dois mandatos: garantir os preceitos constitucionais do direito a uma vida digna, sem fome. Os dados revelados pelo Mapa da Fome da ONU nesta semana reforçam que estamos cumprindo esta missão. Entre 2023 e 2025, o Brasil reduziu em mais de 90% o número de pessoas em insegurança alimentar grave, para 0,6%. O índice chegou a 8,5% nos tempos em que o país retornou ao Mapa da Fome. O resultado é retrato de uma articulação de 80 ações e programas de vários ministérios, com foco no acesso à renda, proteção social e apoio à produção e ao consumo de alimentos adequados, tudo em torno do Plano Brasil sem Fome. Fazem parte dessa equação tanto iniciativas mais conhecidas, como Bolsa Família e Gás do Povo, quanto o Programa de Aquisição de Alimentos, o reajuste e a qualificação da merenda escolar, a volta do financiamento à agricultura familiar, as cozinhas solidárias, o fomento rural, o programa Cisternas, o BPC e o Luz do Povo, para citar alguns. Não à toa, os resultados do Mapa da Fome se conectam com indicadores macroeconômicos que permitem essa melhora da condição de vida de milhões de brasileiros. O PIB acumulou altas nos três últimos anos, a taxa de desemprego registra os menores dados da série histórica, o rendimento médio mensal real domiciliar alcançou o maior valor já registrado pelo IBGE e o salário mínimo voltou a ter ganho real. Como disse naquele discurso de posse, os direitos e interesses da população, o fortalecimento da democracia e a retomada da soberania nacional são pilares de nosso governo.

युवाओं और विद्यार्थियों की भावनाओं को ध्यान में रखते हुए केन्द्रीय शिक्षा मंत्री श्री धर्मेंद्र प्रधान ने अपने पद से इस्तीफ़ा दे दिया है। श्री धर्मेंद्र प्रधान का इस्तीफ़ा इस बात का प्रमाण है कि प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेंद्र मोदी जी और हमारी सरकार के लिए हमारे विद्यार्थियों और युवाओं की भावनाओं का सम्मान और उनके उज्ज्वल भविष्य के लिये प्रतिबद्धता सर्वोपरि हैं। NEET परीक्षा, पेपर लीक और शिक्षा व्यवस्था में आवश्यक सुधारों को लेकर विद्यार्थियों के मन में जो भी चिंताएँ हैं, उनका पूरी गंभीरता और संवेदनशीलता के साथ समाधान किया जा रहा है। विद्यार्थियों की चिंताओं को गंभीरता से सुनना, उनका समाधान सुनिश्चित करना और उनमें यह विश्वास बनाना कि उनकी आवाज़ सुनी जाएगी और उनकी सभी समस्याओं का समाधान होगा, यही हमारी प्राथमिकता है। मुझे विश्वास है कि अब हमारे युवा और विद्यार्थी पूरे आत्मविश्वास के साथ अपनी पढ़ाई, अपने सपनों और अपनी आकांक्षाओं पर ध्यान केंद्रित करेंगे और एक सशक्त, समृद्ध एवं विकसित भारत के निर्माण में अपना महत्वपूर्ण योगदान देंगे। केंद्रीय मंत्री के रूप में श्री धर्मेंद्र प्रधान जी का कार्यकाल भारत को विकसित राष्ट्र बनाने के संकल्प के प्रति उनके समर्पण का परिचायक रहा है। सार्वजनिक जीवन में उनका योगदान समावेशी, दूरदर्शी और नए भारत की आकांक्षाओं के अनुरूप रहा है।

The advance of two armies and a tank division of the Russian armed forces was repelled: forces of the First Corps Azov of the National Guard of Ukraine destroyed dozens of units of equipment and a large number of occupier personnel. On July 22, the occupiers, using forces of the 8th and 41st Armies along with the 90th Tank Division, attempted an assault in the sector held by the First Corps Azov of the National Guard of Ukraine, involving dozens of units of armored and light vehicles. The 41st Guards Combined Arms Army and the 90th Guards Vitebsk-Novgorod Tank Division of the Russian armed forces advanced from the area of the settlement of Novoekonomichne, while forces of the 8th Guards Combined Arms Army simultaneously advanced from the area of the village of Vozdvyzhenka. For four hours, they attempted to enter settlements in the area of the village of Shakhove. The enemy attempted to deny the sky to Ukrainian forces using "Gerbera" and "Lancet" strike drones. A modern Russian "Tornado-S" MLRS, which was being used to support the assault, was also destroyed. Forces of the First Corps Azov of the National Guard of Ukraine, together with attached units, blocked the path of the advancing mechanized columns. Mine-explosive obstacles were laid on the approaches to the positions of the Ukrainian Defense Forces, and bridges were damaged by tactical aviation. During the assault, the Russians attempted to restore the crossings using pontoons, but these were destroyed by tactical aviation of the Air Force of the Armed Forces of Ukraine (AFU). As a result of the professional actions of all units involved under the command of the First Corps Azov of the National Guard of Ukraine, using barrel artillery, multiple launch rocket systems, and attack drones, the following were destroyed: 7 tanks, 6 armored combat vehicles, 1 BM-21 "Grad" MLRS, 1 "Tornado-S" MLRS, 3 units of special equipment, and 47 units of light vehicles. 123 occupiers were eliminated, and 29 were wounded. The mechanized assault was repelled. We thank the units of the First Corps Azov of the National Guard of Ukraine, the SBU's "A" Special Operations Center, the Unmanned Systems Forces, the Air Force of the AFU, units of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine, in particular the Main Department of Unmanned Aerial Systems "Fenix," units of the National Guard of Ukraine, and units of the Armed Forces of Ukraine for their professional and courageous actions. Prezydent @NawrockiKn zarzuca, że ustawa wprowadzająca podatek od dodatkowych zysków koncernów paliwowych jest niekonstytucyjna, bo działa wstecz. Najwyraźniej ktoś w Kancelarii @prezydentpl w tej sprawie słabo doradził... Taka ustawa ze swej istoty może dotyczyć tylko sytuacji przeszłej, bo zyski ustala się po upływie określonego czasu. Skoro te nadzwyczajne zyski wystąpiły, wąska grupa przedsiębiorców na tym skorzystała, a skutki są społecznie dotkliwe – częściowo neutralizowane przez działania rządu obniżające podatki od tych paliw – to istnieje konstytucyjne uzasadnienie, aby taki dodatkowy podatek uchwalić. Oczekiwanie, żeby tego typu przepisy działały wyłącznie na przyszłość, to nieporozumienie. Bo trzeba by uchwalić przepisy "na wypadek", gdyby takie dodatkowe zyski (nie wiadomo, w jakiej wysokości) wystąpiły. Nadzwyczajne zyski mogą być opodatkowane wtedy, kiedy już wystąpiły. A konstytucyjność projektu ustawy była weryfikowana przez Rządowe Centrum Legislacji oraz legislatorów Kancelarii Sejmu i Kancelarii Senatu. Raczej nie o ochronę wartości konstytucyjnych chodziło więc Prezydentowi, kiedy pozbawił budżet państwa dochodów od tych dodatkowych zysków koncernów paliwowych. @PremierRP @MF_GOV_PL @Domanski_Andrz

Divisional Commissioner Kashmir, Anshul Garg, said that the recent rains have caused conditions requiring urgent repair and restoration works along the Pahalgam route. To ensure the uninterrupted continuation of the Yatra, comprehensive arrangements have been made on the Baltal axis for the safe and smooth movement of pilgrims. “Due to the recent rains, urgent repair and maintenance works are required to be carried out on the Pahalgam Axis of Shri Amarnathji Yatra. The Yatra shall continue through the Baltal Axis, for which adequate arrangements have been put in place to ensure a smooth and safe pilgrimage,” the Divisional Commissioner said. As of today, more than 3.95 lakh pilgrims have undertaken darshan at the Holy Amarnath Cave Shrine during this year's Yatra, reflecting the successful and peaceful conduct of the pilgrimage."

Russian feedback about using UGVs🔽 1. Before using the UGV, it is necessary to review the route of movement with the UAV for the purpose of passability. UGV can be stuck relatively easily. It is impossible to simply direct the UGV in a certain direction, as is done with tanks or IGVs. This will most likely lead to the loss of the drone. 2. Basically, UGVs are used for restraining actions (distracting attention); in order to maneuver, the group could strike from a second direction. The enemy always hits the UGV, even when they do not pose a real threat to the enemy's strongholds. Machine-gun UGVs cannot defeat soldiers in a trench. UGVs with AGS-17 have limited ammunition and cannot take part in the battle for a long time. The absence of significant targets leads to the fact that the UAV operators still try to defeat the UGV. This allows you to use them to call FPV drone strikes on yourself. 3. If possible, the UGV will drive as close as possible to the point of launch on a cargo vehicle. 4. UGVs break down a lot. Spare batteries and control antennas (retranslators) are needed in large quantities. 5. A UGV is operated by the calculation of 2–3 people. 6. Unlike analog FPV drones, which react almost instantly to control commands, UGVs can react with a delay. Digital channels are used in UGV controls, which often introduce such a delay. 7. UAVs are used to accompany the movement of the UGV. Visibility from the ground is usually insufficient for controlling a UGV. 8. The UGV controlled by radio channels, like the UAVs, requires installation of control antennas and the use of repeaters. 9. It happens that a scheme is being implemented in which the UGV is moving forward on fiber optic and comes back with the help of a management UAV. The duplicating control system, which allows controlling the UGV from the UAV, is also necessary due to the fact that the quality of the cable unwound for the UGV can be low. This, in particular, can lead to the fact that after 200 meters of movement, the image will disappear.

LOOK: The University of the Philippines' Institute for Maritime Affairs and Law of the Sea (IMLOS) has released an updated edition of its West Philippine Sea primer, offering a "concise yet comprehensive" guide to the territorial and maritime disputes from the Philippine perspective. Titled "The West Philippine Sea: The Territorial and Maritime Jurisdiction Disputes from a Filipino Perspective (The WPS Primer 2026)," the 95-page publication builds on the original primer released in 2013 by IMLOS and the UP Asian Center. It incorporates major developments over the past decade, including the landmark 2016 South China Sea Arbitration ruling, which affirmed the Philippines' sovereign rights and jurisdiction over its exclusive economic zone in the West Philippine Sea. The primer is available for free download through the IMLOS website. (📷: UP IMLOS/Facebook)

🔥 Au cœur des feux de forêt, un seul objectif : protéger la population. Engagés en Gironde aux côtés du SDIS 33, les sapeurs-pompiers de Paris poursuivent leur mission dans des conditions particulièrement éprouvantes. Face à un incendie encore difficilement maîtrisable, les équipes sont pleinement mobilisées pour protéger les habitations, contenir la progression des flammes et participer aux évacuations lorsque la situation l'exige. Sur le terrain, les sapeurs-pompiers de Paris, du SDIS 77 et de la Gironde travaillent main dans la main. Au-delà des uniformes et des écussons, c'est une même mission qui les rassemble : préserver des vies, protéger les biens et soutenir les populations confrontées à cette épreuve. Dans ce type d'intervention, chaque geste compte. La coordination, la confiance et la solidarité entre les équipes sont des forces essentielles pour faire face à un feu imprévisible, où les conditions peuvent évoluer en quelques instants. Les journées sont longues, les températures élevées et l'engagement physique est intense. Mais ensemble, les femmes et les hommes engagés sur le terrain avancent avec la même détermination, animés par un seul objectif : remplir leur mission jusqu'au bout. 👏 Courage à l'ensemble des sapeurs-pompiers mobilisés en Gironde. Drowning claims around 300,000 lives every year. That is 30 people every hour. Nearly 1 in 4 are children under 5. As heatwaves become more frequent, more people seek relief in rivers, lakes and the sea, increasing their exposure to drowning risks. Yet drowning is largely preventable. This year’s World Drowning Prevention Day theme, “Unite to turn the tide”, calls for governments, communities and individuals to work together to reduce the toll. Between 2000 and 2021, the global drowning death rate fell by 38%, showing what sustained efforts can achieve. The first-ever Global Strategy for Drowning Prevention aims to build on this progress, targeting 35% fewer deaths by 2035. Governments can accelerate progress by expanding supervised childcare and swimming education, making water sources and pools safer, strengthening flood warnings and safety standards for water transport. Each of us also has a part to play: watch children closely around water, use lifejackets, learn to swim and develop water-safety skills, and never underestimate the risks. These actions can spare thousands of families a devastating loss.

Let's unpack the options for what the US government could do to potentially restrict Chinese AI models: 1. FUD: @deanwball noted the other day that the US government could take a "FUD" approach of just creating lots of doubt and uncertainty about use of Chinese AI, rather than strict legal requirements. (Dean made this point as an analytic matter, he was not advocating for it). The government could issue public security advisories, get sectoral regulators like energy and financial regulators to start raising risks, etc. This might not legally prohibit use, but would likely discourage it. 2. Procurement bans: The U.S. government could use procurement authorities to prohibit the use of Chinese AI models in government contracts, similar to what DoD did to Anthropic earlier this year. This would not prohibit private companies from using Chinese AI models unrelated to government contracts, but it would discourage use and reinforce a FUD approach. 3. Entity List: The Commerce Department could put specific Chinese AI companies (Moonshot, etc.) on the Entity List, which would prohibit exports of US technology to them. Setting aside evasion, this would cut off their access to any remaining US-origin chips not already covered by more general export controls and to US software. It would also potentially complicate U.S. companies’ use of closed or hosted models, as a US company could not send its own software or other "items" to the Chinese company for processing. It would not, however, strictly legally prohibit a U.S. company from downloading an open source model that a Chinese AI company posted online, as the download would not be an export *to* China, but rather an import from it. 4. "ICTS" rule: Commerce's existing "ICTS rule" allows Commerce to restrict the import or US use of a variety of software and other technology that poses a national security risk. Commerce has used the ICTS rule to, inter alia, prevent Americans from using Kaspersky Lab software (from Russia) and it is the basis for the recently-in-the-news restrictions on Polestar autos. Commerce could in theory deploy the rule to prohibit US firms from using Chinese AI models in the US. The one potential caveat to this is that the ICTS Rule exists pursuant to IEEPA, and IEEPA cannot regulate the import (or export) of "information" or "informational materials." I think courts would almost certainly uphold the ICTS rule as applied to the import or use of Chinese-hosted AI models as a prohibition on a “service,” and not on “information.” There would, however, be an interesting question about whether the courts would uphold a ban on a simple US download of an open-source Chinese model, where there was no payment. 5. Sanctions on Chinese AI labs: The President could use IEEPA to impose sanctions on Chinese AI labs, likely after declaring a new national emergency related to adversarial country AI risks. This would block their property in the US and prohibit all US commercial transactions with them. However, IEEPA sanctions would have the same carve out for "information" or "informational materials" as applies to the ICTS rule, and there is some chance the courts would find that IEEPA sanctions cannot prevent a US company from downloading, for free, an open source Chinese model. (Courts, for example, blocked Trump's 2020 use of IEEPA to try to restrict TikTok in the United States). 6. New IEEPA-derived restrictions on US companies using/deploying Chinese AI models: IEEPA is a flexible statute and the Trump Administration could use IEEPA to create new restrictions on the use or deployment of Chinese AI models, for example prohibiting US companies from using the models both in the US and abroad and prohibiting US hyperscalers from making Chinese AI models available in the US or globally. This could either be an outright prohibition, or a restriction, e.g., Chinese models could only be used subject to certain conditions, such as security protocols. (There is some conceptual parallel to how the Department of Justice's Data Security Program works). (There would, however, still be the legal question about whether IEEPA could in fact prevent a US company from simply downloading and using a free Chinese open source model). 7. Congressional legislation: Congress could of course legislate new restrictions on the US use of Chinese AI models. This would avoid the IEEPA limitations discussed above related to “information,” though would still be subject to the First Amendment. I could see the courts upholding a congressional ban on the use of even free open-source AI models despite the first Amendment by finding that such a ban passes “intermediate scrutiny.” (This was part of the basis on which SCOTUS upheld *Congress’s* 2024 legislation requiring a divestment of TikTok after lower courts enjoined Trump’s 2020 IEEPA-based ban). Note: this post is intended solely as a rundown of what the legal options for restrictions are, not a normative argument on what the US government should do. 🇺🇦🇨🇦 We held a substantive discussion with Canada’s Minister of Energy and Natural Resources Tim Hodgson @timhodgsonmt. The key topics were cooperation in the gas sector and nuclear energy. We aim to further diversify gas supply routes. Ukraine has proposed creating a strategic energy security bridge with Canada focused on the supply of Canadian LNG to Ukraine. Following the agreements reached by President of Ukraine @ZelenskyyUa and Prime Minister of Canada @MarkJCarney, we discussed with the Minister the preparation and benefits of concluding a long-term 30-year strategic energy agreement. We discussed Ukraine’s preparations for the upcoming winter, including the possibility of direct grant support from Canada for gas purchases for Ukraine in the amount of CAD 650 million, as part of the overall support package for Ukraine this year. Ukraine also invited Canadian suppliers to use Ukrainian underground gas storage facilities. Another important topic was the supply of energy equipment from Canadian manufacturers to Ukraine. We also touched upon nuclear energy cooperation. Ukraine is interested in Canada’s experience and opportunities in the development of SMRs — small modular reactors. We agreed that this area will become part of our strategic energy agreement. I thanked my colleague for Canada’s unwavering support for Ukraine and for Minister Hodgson’s personal role in advancing our energy partnership at various levels. We highly value the assistance provided through the Ukraine Energy Support Fund. Hold on: The Time for Policy Patience Is Not Over PIDE's latest Monetary Policy Assessment recommends that the State Bank of Pakistan (@StateBank_Pak) maintain the policy rate at 11.5 percent at its upcoming Monetary Policy Committee meeting. Although headline inflation has eased to 11.1 percent, underlying price pressures remain persistent, with elevated core inflation, volatile weekly prices, and higher petroleum costs continuing to pose upside risks. At the same time, economic recovery is gaining traction but remains uneven, with weak large-scale manufacturing suggesting limited demand-side inflationary pressures. Market signals also support a cautious approach. Treasury-bill yields remain closely aligned with the current policy rate, while improved reserves and strong remittance inflows provide policy space despite continuing external vulnerabilities. PIDE's policy recommendation is clear: maintain the policy rate at 11.5 percent. A gradual easing cycle should begin only when disinflation is firmly established, inflation expectations are well anchored, and external sector stability is sustained. The DNA’s ‘double helix’ structure was discovered thanks in part to Rosalind Franklin. Today is her birthday! In 1962, James Watson, Francis Crick, and Maurice Wilkins confirmed the molecular structure of DNA by relying heavily on Franklin’s hypotheses and photographs of DNA strands created with X-ray diffraction. The three men won the @NobelPrize in Physiology or Medicine for discovering the double helix structure of DNA. While Franklin did not win a share of the Nobel Prize despite her essential contributions, her work has not been forgotten.

🔈 PR No. 1️⃣8️⃣8️⃣/2️⃣0️⃣2️⃣6️⃣ Visit of the Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister of Pakistan Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 to participate in the Shanghai Cooperation Organization Council of Foreign Ministers’ meeting in Cholpon-Ata, Kyrgyz Republic from 23-24 July 2026 🔗⬇️

Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 met with the Foreign Minister of Uzbekistan, Bakhtiyor Saidov @FM_Saidov, on the sidelines of the SCO CFM Meeting in Cholpon-Ata, Kyrgyzstan. The two Ministers reaffirmed the strength of the Pakistan-Uzbekistan strategic partnership and reviewed progress in bilateral cooperation across trade, investment, connectivity, energy, culture, and people-to-people exchanges. They emphasized the importance of sustained high-level exchanges and closer engagement between the business communities of both countries to further expand economic ties. They also discussed cooperation at regional and multilateral forums. Both Ministers recalled the successful visit of President Shavkat Mirziyoyev to Pakistan earlier this year and underscored the importance of translating the understandings reached during the visit into tangible outcomes through timely implementation. The two sides also exchanged views on regional and global developments. Foreign Minister Saidov appreciated Pakistan’s diplomatic efforts to promote regional peace and stability, including its role in facilitating the Islamabad MoU. Both sides expressed hope that dialogue and diplomacy would continue to pave the way for lasting peace and regional stability. The two Ministers agreed to remain in close contact.

NITI Aayog, in partnership with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), convened the Japan–India Forum on Adopting Japanese Best Practices for India's Aspirational Districts and Blocks, bringing together policymakers, development practitioners, academia, and experts from both countries to strengthen bilateral cooperation and exchange knowledge for improving development outcomes. Ms. Nidhi Chhibber, CEO, NITI Aayog, highlighted the importance of taking the India–Japan partnership beyond the achievement of saturation and leveraging global expertise through the collaboration between NITI Aayog and JICA. Shri K. S. Rejimon, Mission Director, Aspirational Districts and Blocks Programme, emphasised that the objective is not to replicate Japanese models, but to adapt the principles underlying their success to India's diverse local contexts. Mr. Takuro Takeuchi, Chief Representative, JICA India, shared Japan's experience in achieving balanced regional development and reaffirmed the shared commitment to advancing inclusive and sustainable growth. Exactly. Kaveri was not “almost ready”. It was systematically starved after the 2008 decision under UPA. Target was 81–90 kN wet. What existed was ~72–73 kN with weight and reliability shortfalls, and no domestic high-altitude test facility. Instead of fixing the gaps and continuing parallel development, the programme was delinked from LCA and funding choked. Classic UPA pattern: announce self-reliance, then quietly import. Modi-era revival (Kaveri dry for Ghatak + Kaveri 2.0 with new core) is the first serious attempt to reverse that sabotage. Owning the engine is non-negotiable. The cost of those lost years is still being paid. 🇮🇳

Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 met with the Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister of Kazakhstan, Yermek Kosherbayev, on the sidelines of the SCO CFM Meeting in Kyrgyzstan. The two leaders reviewed the positive momentum in Pakistan-Kazakhstan relations following the visit of President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev to Pakistan earlier this year and reaffirmed their commitment to implementing the understandings reached, including the 37 MoUs signed during the visit. They agreed to intensify cooperation in trade, investment, transport and regional connectivity, energy, people-to-people exchanges, and at multilateral forums. Foreign Minister Kosherbayev appreciated Pakistan’s efforts to advance regional peace and diplomacy. They also exchanged views on regional and global developments and reiterated their shared commitment to peace, stability, and prosperity. Foreign Minister Kosherbayev invited the Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister to visit Kazakhstan, which he graciously accepted at a mutually convenient time.

Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 met with the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Belarus, Mr. Maxim Ryzhenkov, on the sidelines of the SCO Council of Foreign Ministers (CFM) Meeting in Cholpon-Ata. The two sides reviewed Pakistan-Belarus bilateral relations and reaffirmed their commitment to further strengthening cooperation across diverse sectors. They also looked forward to the 9th Session of the Pakistan-Belarus Joint Ministerial Commission, to be hosted by Pakistan in Islamabad on 11–12 August 2026, as well as to continued high-level exchanges. The two leaders discussed ways to expand economic and trade cooperation, deepen collaboration in defence, agriculture, technology, and workforce exchange, and reaffirmed their commitment to the Roadmap for Comprehensive Cooperation (2025–2027). The two Ministers also exchanged views on regional developments and issues of mutual interest. Foreign Minister Ryzhenkov appreciated Pakistan’s constructive role in facilitating dialogue during the U.S.-Iran situation and commended Pakistan’s continued efforts to promote regional peace and security.

Defence Metallurgical Research Laboratory (DMRL), DRDO has transferred three advanced materials technologies to SAIL. Manufacturing technology for DMR-249A and DMR-249BK grade steel billets were transferred to SAIL's Alloy Steel Plant, Durgapur. These billets are used in the construction of Naval Ships and Submarines. The manufacturing technology for DMR-249B steel plates (8-30mm thickness) was transferred to SAIL's Alloy Steel Plant, Durgapur and Rourkela Steel Plant. These steel plates are used in specialised naval construction. Dr R V Hara Prasad, DG(N&SM) handed over the Licensing Agreement for Transfer of Technology (LAToT) to SAIL in the presence of Dr R Balamuralikrishnan, Director DMRL. The transfer of technology to industry marks a significant milestone in strengthening indigenous materials capabilities for strategic defence applications

Man muss das gedanklich erst einmal hinbekommen: Da wird im Kanzleramt ein schon existierender Posten umetikettiert, um angeblich die „Kommunikation zwischen Bund und Ländern“ zu verbessern. Als ob ausgerechnet Philipp Amthor als Staatsminister das bürokratische Dickicht des Föderalismus entwirren würde. Es geht doch überhaupt nicht um Sachpolitik. Das Kind bekommt nur einen schicken Namen. In Wahrheit scharrt Friedrich Merz schlicht seine treuesten Gefolgsleute um sich. Wer auf Parteitagen brav klatscht und bedingungslos strammsteht, wird eben mit einem Büro im Machtzentrum belohnt. Doch die Aktion hat einen noch übleren Beigeschmack: Merz scheint im Inneren des Apparats eine Verschwörung gegen sich zu wittern. Amthor zieht da nicht als Brückenbauer ein, sondern als horchender Aufpasser. Ein persönlicher Spion des Kanzlers, der die eigenen Flurgespräche filtert und dem Chef steckt, wer intern den Aufstand probt. Dass die Länderkommunikation dadurch um keinen Deut besser wird, dürfte allen Beteiligten völlig egal sein. Hauptsache, der Kanzler hat seinen Hofberichterstatter direkt im Haus.

The Cuiyun Corridor Ancient Shu Road (the ancient road system to today's Sichuan province) stretches across Jiange county in Guangyuan and Zitong county in Mianyang, Sichuan province, with the Jiange section forming its principal route. Extending for 151 kilometers, the road is lined with thousands of ancient cypress trees, some dating back to the Qin (221-206 BC) and Han (206 BC-AD 220) dynasties. After more than two millennia, many still stand tall with dense, evergreen foliage. Paved with stone slabs and shaded by towering cypresses, the road winds through tranquil forests. It is home to the world's oldest, largest, and best-preserved avenue of planted roadside trees, with more than 7,000 ancient cypresses over 1,000 years old. The oldest is more than 2,300 years old, nicknamed "a wonder of the Ancient Shu Roads" and "a living fossil forest". chinabound.cn Travel with ease in China, and with meaning. #China #Sichuan #CuiyunCorridor #ChinaBound #ASnapshotOfChina

EL BANCO CENTRAL REALIZÓ UNA FUERTE COMPRA DE DÓLARES Y SUPERA LOS USD 13.000 MILLONES EN 2026 El Banco Central de la República Argentina (BCRA) hilvanó 134 jornadas consecutivas con saldo comprador de divisas tras adquirir USD 345 millones este viernes. De esta manera, la autoridad monetaria superó los USD 13.000 millones comprados en lo que va de 2026. Desde el comienzo de la cuarta etapa del programa monetario y cambiario en enero, el BCRA realizó adquisiciones por 13.101 millones de dólares. El equipo económico había fijado como objetivo anual un rango de entre USD 10.000 y USD 17.000 millones para 2026. Entre enero y julio de 2026, la oferta de dólares aumentó gracias a las liquidaciones del sector agropecuario, energético y minero, junto con la colocación de deuda en mercados internacionales por parte de empresas y gobiernos provinciales. Estos flujos permitieron al Banco Central captar una parte considerable de los dólares disponibles. Infobae 📎 bit.ly/4wl2nAh

महाराष्ट्रावर विठूमाऊलीची कृपादृष्टी सदैव राहो, राज्यात सुख-समृद्धी नांदो, शेतकरी सुखी-समृद्ध होवोत आणि जनतेच्या जीवनात आनंद व समाधान लाभो, अशी प्रार्थना त्यांनी विठूमाऊलीच्या चरणी केली. त्याचबरोबर पंतप्रधाान नरेंद्र मोदी यांनी देशाच्या तरुणाईसाठी सुरू केलेल्या विकास आणि नव्या संधींच्या प्रवासाला अधिक बळ मिळावे, प्रत्येक युवक-युवतीच्या आशा-आकांक्षा पूर्ण व्हाव्यात आणि विकसित भारताच्या निर्मितीचा संकल्प अधिक वेगाने साकार व्हावा, यासाठीही मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी भगवान श्री विठ्ठल आणि रुक्मिणी मातेच्या चरणी प्रार्थना केली. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते आज पंढरपूर येथे मानाचे वारकरी दाम्पत्य श्री. बाळासाहेब माने व श्रीमती प्रभावती माने यांचा सत्कार करण्यात आला. यावेळी मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते 'श्री विठ्ठल निर्मल दिंडी पुरस्कार 2026' प्रदान करण्यात आले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, यंदा वारीने नवा उच्चांक गाठला असून 25 किलोमीटरपेक्षा अधिक अंतरापर्यंत भाविकांची रांग लागली आहे. मात्र, या सर्व भाविकांची अत्यंत चांगल्या प्रकारे व्यवस्था करण्यात आली आहे. श्री विठ्ठल नामाचा गजर करत भाविक दर्शन घेत आहेत. जगाच्या पाठीवर असा आनंदाचा सोहळा दुसरा नाही, जिथे कोणत्याही निमंत्रणाशिवाय लाखो वारकरी आपल्या विठुरायाच्या दर्शनासाठी पायी निघतात. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, पंढरपूर येथे भगवान श्री पांडुरंगाच्या दर्शनासाठी दरवर्षी लाखो भाविक येतात. भाविकांची सातत्याने वाढणारी संख्या लक्षात घेता अधिक प्रशस्त परिसर आणि आवश्यक पायाभूत सुविधा निर्माण करणे काळाची गरज आहे. त्यादृष्टीने यावर्षीच पंढरपूर मंदिर कॉरिडॉरच्या कामाला सुरुवात करण्यात येणार असून, ते पूर्ण झाल्यानंतर दर्शन व्यवस्था अधिक सुलभ, सुव्यवस्थित आणि सुरळीत होईल. वारकऱ्यांची सेवा हीच विठ्ठलसेवा मानत राज्य शासनाने यंदा शेतकऱ्यांसाठी कर्जमाफी आणि मोफत वीज देण्याचा ऐतिहासिक निर्णय घेतला, असेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. यावेळी मंत्री गिरीष महाजन, मंत्री जयकुमार गोरे, मंत्री आकाश फुंडकर, आमदार The New York Times, citing multiple people briefed on the matter, reports that President Donald J. Trump switched from the Qatari donated Boeing 747-8 to the legacy Air Force One during the NATO summit after the Secret Service received what officials deemed a credible threat that Iranian proxy forces were targeting the president and whatever aircraft he was traveling aboard. The Qatari donated 747-8 is currently serving as the VC-25B "Bridge" aircraft, a temporary presidential transport intended to fill the gap until Boeing delivers the long delayed next generation VC-25B fleet. According to the report, the threat was not specific to the aircraft itself, but the incident has renewed scrutiny over its defensive capabilities, as it lacks some of the advanced defensive systems carried by the current VC-25A and future VC-25B fleets. President Trump appeared to acknowledge those limitations earlier this week when, after being asked about the aircraft's lack of antimissile defenses, he told reporters the jet would soon be taken out of service to be "maxed out" with additional upgrades, a process that White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt confirmed would take approximately one month. Basically, we have the old system, led more or less by Commander-in-Chief Syrskyi, which is centered on infantry and artillery, and the new system, led by Fedorov, which is centered on drones, fiber-optic cables, and computer chips. Each requires a massive pipeline of resources, whether that's personnel, funding, or manufacturing capacity. The two systems don't overlap very much. So when Fedorov became defense minister a few months ago, he began shifting resources toward his preferred method of warfare. Syrskyi, understandably, had a bit of a coronary because there was no way he could defend a 1,000-mile-long front without continued investment in artillery and artillery shells. Both of them are right. Both of them are wrong. And now, both of them have been fired. So what's happening now is that President Zelensky is trying to balance these two factions so they can both function because both are essential. The reason the protests in Ukraine in support of Fedorov are continuing is that protesters have looked at the personnel Zelensky has appointed to replace Syrskyi and Fedorov and concluded that, so far, nothing has changed. And that's true.

The route would let the 1 GW facility avoid open-access charges and source power far more cheaply, but the Electricity Act, 2003, makes no provision for a deemed distribution licensee that isn't a government company, which Google is not. Drawing a parallel with the railways case, where the Supreme Court ruled in May that railways is a consumer and not a deemed distribution licensee, Dasgupta warns the Google move risks the same legal fate. 🇺🇸🇮🇷 Trump remains trapped because he still refuses to accept how much leverage Iran possesses. He still thinks overwhelming American power will eventually force Tehran to give in, and political scientist Ian Bremmer says that's the mistake keeping this war alive. Instead, Iran has shown it can keep raising the economic cost of the war without crossing Trump's red lines. Ian doesn't think Iran believes it can defeat the U.S militarily; it believes it can make continuing the war more painful than ending it. And so far, it's working. Trump keeps threatening to destroy Iran's infrastructure, eliminate its leadership and dramatically escalate the conflict. But Ian points to something more revealing than Trump's rhetoric: His actions. Despite months of fighting, Trump has avoided the biggest escalations. No ground invasion, no sustained campaign against Iran's energy sector, and no full-scale assault on the country's leadership. Even after American casualties, his instinct has repeatedly been to play them down rather than use them to justify a much wider war. And Tehran has noticed. It increasingly sees a president who talks like he's preparing for total war but behaves like someone searching for an exit. The bigger problem, Ian says, is inside the White House itself. Trump's advisers know the military and economic costs are mounting, and many want the war to end, but very few are willing to tell Trump the uncomfortable truth: Iran has far more leverage over how this ends than Washington expected. Until Trump accepts that reality, Ian believes a genuine compromise remains unlikely. @ianbremmer Video

On the Dangers of U.S Unilateralism Abroad The new era of great power competition between autocrats and democrats will be fierce, challenging, and enduring. I believe the free world has more resources, superior institutions, and better ideas than the autocratic world. At the same time, many of the challenges we face today, especially from China, are different and more complex than they were during the Cold War. China’s highly sophisticated strategy of multilateralism is far more successful than anything the Soviets tried or achieved. Beijing does not want to destroy the old international economic and political architecture, as the Soviets did. Instead, it has worked within existing institutions—the UN, the World Bank, the WTO—while simultaneously creating new ones, including BRICS, the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO), and the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI). Starting new international clubs, as well as fostering win-win outcomes for countries that join, is a conscious, deliberate strategy for advancing Chinese interests and influence globally. Last week, Xi launched one more international club: the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization (WAICO). Through WAICO, Beijing hopes to shape the international rules governing artificial intelligence independently of the United States. At its founding meeting last week, 29 countries signed the founding agreement, with more expected to follow. Tragically, Trump has pursued the exact opposite strategy to Xi—exiting old international organizations and agreements and failing to create much new.
